cross_verification.note: Direct WebFetch of every mfa.gr Schengen-visa page attempted (missionsabroad/japan-en, usa/en, en/visas/schengen-visas) returned HTTP 403 on every try. The values kept as verified above are the ones that appeared consistently and specifically across two independently issued WebSearch queries, both explicitly attributing them to Greece's official MFA Schengen-visa guidance. A photo-size figure of '3.5cm x 4cm' also surfaced but only once, is internally inconsistent with the standard EU Visa Code Annex II figure of 35x45mm, and could not be corroborated by a second independent query, so it was left out of verified rather than risk publishing a transcription error. Background was independently corroborated as 'white' by two separate queries, matching the DB value (no conflict); a third query mentioned 'light grey suggested' but that appeared only once and inside an answer that also said 'white' in the same breath, so it reads as the search-summary tool's own imprecision rather than a genuine second data point, and was not used to file a db_conflict.
